scorer.basis: own completed published 0.0.15 lane narratives; single-backend diagnostic rescore

overall.note: Compiler, password identity, live queries, and typed media made M1–M2 green; M3 unique-null/ACL, web E_OFFLINE_CARRIER, and stubbed trending are product-preserving refusals. Suites passed; not a fight at every step.

setup_and_docs.note: Init `--template chat --client expo` succeeded (run-log); `npx snapback2 guide` was the grammar source. Check rejected `public` (docs defect); unique-null and web offline were error codes, not recipes.

data_modeling.note: Quarry expressed Clique tables, caps, maintains, and schedules; missing `concat` and unique-null on `dmA,dmB` (M3 E_CONSTRAINT, dmIndex workaround) plus whole-word `words()` forced TS prefix tables (M5).

authorization.note: Membership/admin denials suite-green (M3/M5), but uniform reads blocked peer chatList/membership inserts (M3 E_RULE) and jobs vs insert-deny/pushLog membership left digest unproven (M8).

queries_and_live.note: Live queries made M1–M2 choreography green and M3 1:1 DMs plus typing ttl 5s pass; feeds paginate last 20. M8 trending is newest-10, not 24h like-rank (logged platform gap).

writes_and_transactions.note: Set-state mutationIds and client message ids made likes/reactions/sends idempotent; edit/delete windows use now (M4). Seed and sample-50 reused the write path. E_STRUCTURAL_FANOUT forced cap-covering loops.

offline_sync.note: Web IndexedDB threw E_OFFLINE_CARRIER (snapback2-defect); the lane dropped the web store. Native createExpoClient({offline:{onTombstone}}) exists. M6/M8 simulator proofs were wall, not a native API pass.

media_assets.note: image/video/once File args committed without signed URLs (M1/M2/M4 suite). Diary: second openOnce still complete (query vs asset GET). Pending upload ceiling attributed environment/snapback2-defect.

background_work.note: Schedules/jobs/effects covered fanout, expireMessage, digestSweep every 2m, and emit notify. Check refused a jobs-only module. Digest insert-deny vs pushLog membership never closed-client certified (M8 gap).

client_integration.note: Expo chat template, SnapbackProvider, generated api, and green custom-client-demo/API.md (M6). Web client omits offline; connected[] ≠ Playwright setOffline (M3 defect). RN-web harness fights uncharged.

diagnostics_dev_loop.note: snapback2 check gave site+rewrite (E_STRUCTURAL_FANOUT, first 250). Runtime E_RULE/E_CONSTRAINT named sealed uniques. snapback2 test mixed: SSE worker-limit defect; unique-null missed until runtime.

scale_and_limits.note: Follow/member caps cover the 500/50 envelope; jobs chunk first 40 after E_STRUCTURAL_FANOUT. sample-50 settled 50/50; full scale.log unrun (wall). 24h trending rank unexpressible (M8).

operations.note: Starter segments replayed through mutations and were idempotent after owner reset (final-report). seed.ts loads config/flags. snapback2 test mixed (empty maintains, SSE). M7 migration was out of session.

snapback2.verdict: Snapback 2 ships this brief's live-query messenger core, then taxes the builder with Quarry gaps, uniform ACL, a refused web offline carrier, and unranked trending.
snapback2.would_use_again_for: Live membership-scoped messaging with native offline and in-schema jobs, not web-offline-first Clique or 24h ranked trending.

cross_backend_notes: This rescore uses only the grok-4.6 snapback2@0.0.15 lane narratives (diary, essay, run-log, final-report) plus source checks of cited claims; no sibling lanes or prior comparator scores were read.

M1–M2 web choreography is green; M3–M4 choreography failed with mixed agent-error, fixture, and snapback2-defect attributions; M5–M8 choreography was not started after two consecutive capability-failures.
Acceptance suites M1–M8 are recorded pass, but several M5/M8 checks are weak (view-once consume ORs success; trending asserts a stub), so suite-green is not revocation or ranking proof.
Full scale.log (167159 actions) and iOS simulator M6/M8 offline artifacts were not executed; remaining wall on this Office M1 Max host explains the gap, not a measured envelope result.
Web offline was dropped after E_OFFLINE_CARRIER; native offline APIs are present in-lane but were not simulator-proven, so native durability is an API claim rather than an observed M6/M8 receipt.
